static_observations: The +0x28D and +0x28E bytes form a paired index interface rather than independent flags.
Multiple setup paths assign the ordered pair 0 and 1, so that ordering alone cannot identify Gate owner versus challenger.
The battle constructor uses the pair symmetrically to build two combatant records.
Candidate result handlers consume the pair later, making them suitable runtime breakpoint targets for ownership and targeting confirmation.
No static path in this checkpoint proves human/AI identity or canonical Gate ownership.
